format: Legendary Collection (LC, 2002): cards not already in the pool. Unlimited only. Every other card is a print of a Base Set, Jungle, Fossil, Team Rocket, Evolutions, Generations, Celebrations, 30th Celebration or Wizards promo card.

attacks.name: Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin. On heads, the Defending Pokémon becomes Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Energy Conversion
attacks.text: Put up to 2 Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand. This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.
